verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' docs list speaker diarization for up to 32 speakers and expose a diarization threshold parameter on the convert API, so developers can request and tune it. Marketing copy says Scribe v2 'distinguishes and labels every speaker' in transcripts. missing for 10: documentation of the response schema showing per-word or per-segment speaker labels, independent or hands-on corroboration of diarization accuracy

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: Diarization threshold to apply during speaker diarization.
Scribe v2 intuitively distinguishes and labels every speaker
